display.purpose: Guest welcome and staff dashboard title; Cormorant Garamond 700.

body.purpose: Task copy, data, and guest names in IBM Plex Sans.

label.purpose: Form labels and compact operational metadata in IBM Plex Sans 600.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Guest invitation on the deep-paper surround; removed on narrow mobile.

shadows.name: night-gate-lift
shadows.purpose: Staff login card against the navy gate.

motion.name: action-transition
motion.value: background .18s ease-out, box-shadow .18s ease-out, transform .18s ease-out

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes confirmation animation and primary-button transitions.

breakpoints.name: guest-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Widen and center the invitation content; increase the page surround.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Full-bleed invitation, stacked dashboard header and filters, reduced table columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action for check-in and staff-code submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 58px; padding: .75rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid #152b45; border-radius: 12px; background: #152b45; color: #f5efe4; font: 600 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans', Arial, sans-serif; transition: background .18s ease-out, box-shadow .18s ease-out, transform .18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #213e61; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 9px 20px rgba(21, 43, 69, .18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9d7432; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Guest Field
components.description: Large, quiet form control for the mobile guest check-in sequence.
components.css: .ds-guest-field { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbbca4; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #152b45; font: 400 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-guest-field::placeholder { color: #697483; } .ds-guest-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9d7432; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Invitation Sheet
components.description: The centered, framed paper surface for guest arrival and confirmation.
components.css: .ds-invitation { position: relative; width: min(100%, 560px); min-height: 760px; padding: clamp(2rem, 8vw, 4.6rem) clamp(1.35rem, 8vw, 4.4rem) 1.9rem; background: #f5efe4; border: 1px solid #cbbca4; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(33, 27, 18, .13); text-align: center; } .ds-invitation h1 { margin: 0; color: #152b45; font: 700 clamp(3.45rem, 15vw, 5.25rem)/.9 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-mark { display: block; width: 13px; height: 13px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; transform: rotate(45deg); border: 1px solid #9d7432; } .ds-ornament { display: block; width: 126px; height: 1px; margin: 1.65rem auto 1.55rem; background: #9d7432; }

components.name: Ledger Total
components.description: A stable three-column attendance summary with tabular serif figures.
components.css: .ds-ledger-total { display: grid; gap: .25rem; padding: 2rem 1rem 2rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbbca4; color: #152b45; } .ds-ledger-total strong { font: 700 clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.25rem)/.8 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-total span { color: #415166; font: 400 .82rem 'IBM Plex Sans', Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Guests arrive through a calm ivory invitation marked with antique-gold geometry and deep-navy type. Staff inherit the same paper-and-ink language in a flat, scan-first attendance ledger. The system avoids generic dashboard cards and reserves decoration for the arrival ritual.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, navy ink, and scarce antique-gold accents.
Fine ledger rules and explicit column alignment organize the interface.
Ceremonial serif headings are paired with operational sans-serif controls and data.
Guest and staff surfaces share materials while changing density and hierarchy for their jobs.

rules.name: The Rare-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold draws lines, marks progress, and frames ceremony; it does not become a large surface or ordinary body text.

rules.name: The Serif Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use Cormorant for page and section headings, event marks, and ledger totals; keep controls and operational copy in IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Staff data is organized with rules, alignment, and tonal tracks rather than floating cards or pervasive shadows.

dos: Do preserve the paper, ink, and fine-rule visual grammar.
Do use the invitation composition for guest arrival and the ledger composition for staff operations.
Do preserve 54px guest touch controls and the shared gold focus outline.
Do remove motion when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass effects, rounded dashboard cards, or dense iconography.
Don't use serif display type for controls, labels, filters, or status text.
Don't use green, red, or gold as generic decorative fills.
Don't retain all four staff-table columns on narrow phones at the expense of legibility.
